create_TAPIRPredictor: create a TAPIRPredictor instance with bootstap mode enabled to load the bootstapir checkpoint model
run_forward_tracking: run the TAPIRPredictor forward pass on video RGB frames with query points to get tracks and visibility
postprocess_occlusions: postprocess occlusion and expected distance tensors to compute a binary visibility mask for tracked points
review_TAPIRPredictor_init: review the TAPIRPredictor class init to understand how it loads standard or bootstap TAPIR checkpoints
refactor_forward_interpolation: refactor the TAPIRPredictor forward method to support variable interpolation shapes instead of hardcoded 256x256
